settings.description_override: The Meridian has a composed kind of ease. A softly structured shape, pebbled leather and silver-tone accents bring definition without feeling formal. From a morning appointment to a table booked for two, it suits the woman who likes her everyday pieces to feel considered.
settings.fact_detail: Made by artisans with 10 years of experience

settings.heading: Details
settings.content: The Meridian combines an open top with short, flat handles, folded side gussets and silver-tone front fittings. Inside, a central zipped compartment separates two open sections. Approximate dimensions are 37 × 24 × 15 cm (W × H × D).

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Wipe the leather with a soft, dry cloth. Keep it away from prolonged moisture, direct heat and sunlight, and store it loosely filled to support its shape.

settings.heading: Shipping & delivery
settings.content: Please allow 10 days from your order to dispatch. Delivery time is additional and varies by destination. You will receive tracking details when your order ships. See our shipping policy for delivery information.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.content: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for unused items in their original packaging with tags attached. To arrange a return, contact customerservice@velantrafashion.com. See our return policy for full conditions.
